description: Turns a phasor into a clock, splitting each input cycle into a chosen number of evenly spaced pulses, with a ramp across each one

params.text: Sets how many pulses one cycle of the input phasor produces, 1 to 64, 16 when new
Attenuverts the steps CV, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V adds 64 steps
Sets the width of the clock pulses, from no pulse at -5V through 50% at the centre to a gate that never drops at +5V
Raw compares the phasor against the width setting directly; Smart mutes the output when the phasor is not moving and mirrors the pulse when it runs backwards

inputs.text: Adds to the step count, scaled by the steps attenuverter
Adds to the pulse width, scaled by the width attenuverter

outputs.text: 10V pulses, one per step, as wide as the width setting
A 0-10V ramp across the current step, restarting on every step

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
